content_sections.heading: NIPER Ahmedabad Job Description
content_sections.text: Chief Executive Officer – Biopharma Incubation Centre (BIC) Identify potential start-ups/idea for incubation and develop the facility accordingly. Manage/Purchase/procure and commission equipments/instruments and research facilities. Preparation of inventory of mentors, their expertise and available translatable technologies for start-ups. Organize seminars, hackathons, trainings, workshops and sensitization programs. Assist the faculty coordinators in preparing various report and other related works. Implement measures and policies to make BIC, NIPER Ahmedabad, self-sustainable. Liaison with the different department of the University, Industry, Start-ups and other organization. Technical Manager – Biopharma Incubation Centre (BIC) Act as a Technical cum administrative person directly reporting to CEO of the Biopharma Incubation Center. Contribute to setting up of the lab and office space, development of SOPs, protocols and policies for lab operations in coordination with NIPER-A Management. Contribute to building scientific support systems and resources for incubatees including specific expertise and library. Manage procurement, shipping, and receiving and inventory management. Contribute to conceptualization and execution of technical workshops, events of use to entrepreneurs, start-ups, budding entrepreneurs etc. Assist startups, students and innovators in design of experiments, setting up lab equipment, connect them to various resource persons. Create a pipeline of potential incubates and any other activities necessary to support and strengthen the bio-pharma incubation mentoring activities. Other tasks assigned by CEO on time-to-time basis.
